# Dental Associates

> Wisconsin-based family dental practice with 12+ clinic locations offering comprehensive general dentistry, orthodontics, pediatric care, implants and oral surgery.

Dental Associates operates multiple clinics across Wisconsin including Milwaukee, Green Bay, Appleton, and surrounding areas. The practice emphasizes family-centered care with online appointment booking, patient resources, and emergency dental services available across all locations.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Oral Surgery
- Dental Implants
- General Dentistry
- Wisconsin Locations
- Appointment Booking
- Patient Resources

- Green Bay Area

## Clinic Locations
